paper_title: Feedback Friction LLMs Struggle to Fully Incorporate External Feedback
caption: Accuracy of Llama3.3 on PopQA with respect to s_pop and o_pop
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between accuracy and s_pop frequency. The x-axis is labeled “s_pop frequency (x10^4)” and has a linear scale ranging from 1 to 19, with tick marks at each integer value. The y-axis is labeled “Accuracy” and has a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick marks at intervals of 0.2. One line is represented in blue with circular markers and a dashed line style; it begins at approximately (1, 0.8) and increases to approximately (7, 0.9), remains relatively stable around 0.9 until x=13, then declines to approximately (19, 0.9). Vertical error bars are present at each x-axis value. Another line is represented in green with square markers and a solid line style; it begins at approximately (1, 0.4) and increases to approximately (7, 0.7), then declines to approximately (13, 0.5) before increasing to approximately (19, 0.5). Vertical error bars are present at each x-axis value.
